t: Created by Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha, who conquered the Kathmandu Valley in 1768–1769.
Defeat by Britain in 1814–1816 fixed its borders; hereditary Rana prime ministers ruled in the king’s name from 1846 to 1951.
Popular movements and a Maoist insurgency ended the monarchy, which the Constituent Assembly abolished in 2008.
dyk: Prithvi Narayan Shah called his kingdom ‘a yam between two boulders’, squeezed between China and British India, a phrase still quoted in debates on Nepal’s foreign policy.
ev: Gorkhali troops capture Kathmandu during the Indra Jatra festival
A Qing army forces Nepal to make peace
Treaty of Sugauli ends the Anglo-Nepalese War
The Kot massacre brings Jang Bahadur Rana to power
Jang Bahadur issues the Muluki Ain law code
King Mahendra dismisses parliament and introduces the panchayat system
The Constituent Assembly abolishes the monarchy
